Any principal or other designated school administrator employed by the Board, in order to maintain proper control and discipline over pupils under his or her care and supervision, may, in the exercise of sound discretion, administer corporal punishment to any pupil or pupils under his or her care and supervision.

The Pierce County Board of Education, believing that discipline is an absolute necessity in the classroom of the schools of Pierce County if every child is to receive a quality basic education, does hereby approve the use of corporal punishment in the schools of Pierce County.
